# 1.36.0: Rosa answers again, and in the mood he is in

Settings, keys and conversations from earlier versions are read as they are.

## Rosa no longer goes silent

- When his model answered with plain text instead of the expected format, Rosa's mind stopped,
  and he did not answer anything until the program was restarted. A plain-text answer in a talk
  is now taken as his reply; anywhere else it is ignored, and one failed request no longer
  silences him.
- A request to his model now gives up after 45 seconds instead of five minutes, so one slow
  answer no longer holds back the talk behind it. When a request fails, he says his words ran
  away.
- When his model only wanted to do something (cuddle, play) without saying a word, the talk
  counted as failed. Now he is asked once more for the words.
- **Talk** in his menu did nothing while he walked around or played. Now he stops and listens.
- His words no longer contradict what he does. His model used to be offered every action he
  knows, while Rosa silently skipped most of them (in the chat almost all of them), so he wrote
  "I'm lying down" and kept sitting. Now his model is offered only what he can actually do at that
  moment, one action per answer, and is told not to describe anything else. In the chat he can now
  lie down, nap and cuddle on the spot; he still doesn't walk away from the panel.
- With **Auto** in the Rosa slot and no Venice key he never answered. Auto now takes the default
  model of your key's provider.

## Rosa answers in his mood

His model now sees his day: how you treated him today (pets, treats, games, nose boops, tail
pulls, throws), what he did himself (bites, refusals to come, mischief), how much annoyance and
joy the day brought, how offended and how tired he is. His tone follows it. Offended, or annoyed
by you today, he answers prickly and short, but without rude words; pleased, he is warm; tired,
he is sleepy. His reactions to your chat messages follow the same mood. Your words are sent
exactly as before; the day is sent as numbers.

## Rosa's friendship is earned

Before, one action repeated over and over (booping his nose, a soft landing, praise, a kind talk)
raised his friendship without end.

- Friendship grows by at most 6 a day and falls by at most 18 a day, however often you repeat
  something. **Our friendship** says when it won't grow any more today.
- A wrong (pulling his tail, shaking him, a hard throw, rudeness, forgetting him for days) now
  weighs twice as much, and he remembers it. While he remembers, kindness warms him less. Hours
  don't make him forget; each kind day with attention and no wrongs erases part of it. Being kind
  from the start pays off. His model knows he remembers, and **Our friendship** shows it.
- Offended or cold, he may refuse to talk: **Talk** and **Chat** then don't open, and he turns
  away. He may also refuse to be held: he bites your hand and breaks free. Shaking him when he is
  angry always ends that way.
- With **Mischief** on, his bite knocks the mouse cursor aside. Turn **Mischief** off and he
  only bites.

## Games

- **End the game** in Rosa's menu stops any game early: laser, tag, hide and seek, ball, or a
  game he started himself. **Esc** works as before.
- Rosa can now catch the laser dot. Before, he only ran along his edge and hopped in place. A dot
  that touches him is caught; a dot just above him he jumps for. Keep it moving if you don't want
  him to win.
- In tag, pressing on him now catches him. Before, catching a running fox turned into picking him
  up, and the game silently ended.

## Chat with Rosa

**Chat** in Rosa's menu opens a small panel right above him with your past talks and a field to
write to him. It does not cover or block the program: you keep working while it is open, it moves
with Rosa, and **Esc** or the cross closes it. His replies appear in the panel. He now remembers up to 50 talks
instead of 12; his model still sees only the last six. The talks live in his memory file, so the
data archive, encryption and **Delete all data** cover them as before.

## Two new dark themes

- **Onyx**: a blue-tinted near-black, with thin cool borders and a silver-blue accent.
- **Carbon**: neutral graphite in the style of the ChatGPT desktop app: a darker sidebar, soft
  grey buttons and menus, and a white main button.

Both are in **Settings → Appearance → Theme**.

## Interface

- Interface scale has two new steps: 115% and 120%.
- The accent focus frame no longer appears around whole areas (the settings navigation, lists,
  panels) after a key press. It stays on buttons, switches, drop-downs and sliders, where it shows
  where Tab went.

## Rolling back

Rolling back to 1.35 keeps your settings. A 115% or 120% scale becomes 100% there, and Onyx or
Carbon shows as the plain dark or light theme; coming back to 1.36 brings your choice back. Rosa
keeps his friendship on 1.35, but forgets the wrongs he remembered.
